h3.label: H3 · h3-rs
h3.blurb: MiniMax-H3 and its distillations with audio, the fastest path on Blackwell (stored MXFP8, INT8 / FP8 attention).

fastwan.label: FastWan · fastwan-rs
fastwan.blurb: Wan 2.1 1.3B in seconds, plus Self-Forcing long videos.

fastvideo.label: FastVideo · fastvideo-rs
fastvideo.blurb: The multi-family engine: H3, LTX-2.5 and Wan 2.2 through one jobs API.

fl2v.label: First / last frame
fl2v.help: Keyframes: a first image, optionally a last one (h3: FL2VA).

ref2v.label: Reference
ref2v.help: Keep a subject from reference images (h3 also takes reference video / audio).

regen2k.label: Regenerate 2K
regen2k.help: Refine a 480p / 768p draft to 2560×1440 keeping its composition.

h3.weights.label: DiT weights
h3.weights.help: Stored MXFP8 where the catalog has a quantized file; emulated exactly on pre-Blackwell cards.

h3.vsa_qk8.label: INT8 Q·Kᵀ
h3.vsa_qk8.help: SageAttention-style INT8 scores (17.5 dB band, no artifacts).

h3.stream_blocks.label: Stream blocks from host
h3.stream_blocks.help: Keep block weights in pinned host memory; for cards under ~40 GB (clips byte-identical).

h3.steps.label: Steps
h3.steps.help: Uniform Euler ladder of the base model (ComfyUI's template uses 25).

h3.tables.label: Precomputed AdaLN tables
h3.tables.help: Skip the ~46 s per-run modulation tables when a table for this variant exists on the volume.

h3.preview.label: TAEH3 preview decode
h3.preview.help: Tiny decoder instead of the full video VAE (draft quality).

h3.upscale_factor.label: Real-ESRGAN upscale
h3.upscale_factor.help: Real-ESRGAN animevideov3 after decode; ×4 is sensible up to 480p, ×2 above.

models.label: FastH3 V2 · 8 steps
models.blurb: The fastest full-quality H3: 8 DMD steps, VSA 0.8; stored MXFP8 recipe, 36.6 s denoise + 5.7 s decode on a 600 W PRO 6000.

models.label: FastH3 V1 · 4 steps
models.blurb: 4 DMD steps, VSA 0.9; 30 s on a 5090 against ComfyUI's 33 s.
models.verify: adapter path / tables name against h3-rs docs/runs before first use

models.label: Draft · LongLive-Plug 4 steps
models.blurb: The draft tier: LongLive-Plug's four-step adapter on the base H3, dense attention, no CFG. 480p draft in 8.6 s after load, 768p 30–35 s; refine with Regenerate 2K.

models.label: MiniMax-H3 Turbo · 4 steps (LightX2V)
models.blurb: LightX2V's 4-step LoRA on the base H3; keyframes supported.

models.label: MiniMax-H3 Turbo Ref2VA · 4 steps
models.blurb: Reference-to-video with the Ref2VA DiT and LightX2V's 4-step LoRA (46 s at 768p).

models.label: MiniMax-H3 Turbo · 8 steps (LightX2V v1.2)
models.blurb: LightX2V's 8-step v1.2 LoRA (also modulates AdaLN: tables are computed per run).

models.label: MiniMax-H3 Turbo Ref2VA · 8 steps
models.blurb: Reference-to-video, 8 steps (92.7 s at 768p).

models.label: MiniMax-H3 base · 49 steps
models.blurb: The undistilled model, uniform Euler, dense attention; `steps` is adjustable (25 = ComfyUI's template, 193 s on a 5090).

models.label: MiniMax-H3 CFG-distilled · 49 steps
models.blurb: LongLive-Plug's CFG adapter: classifier-free guidance folded into one forward.
models.verify: adapter location on the volume (h3-rs/cfg) before first use

models.label: FastH3 Omni · Ref2VA 8 steps
models.blurb: Reference-to-video (PDD, 32 heads), 8 × 14.1 s on the Server Edition.

models.label: FastH3 Trim · NVFP4 8 steps
models.blurb: 42-block Trim in NVFP4 from the ComfyUI file (24 GB peak; expanded per GEMM, 8 × 5.5 s).
models.verify: the exact NVFP4 file name under diffusion_models/

models.label: Pika H3 Flex · 6 steps
models.blurb: Pika's keyframe / reference adapters (buckets 480p / 768p, 120-frame floor).

models.label: Open-H3 Regenerate 2K · 3 steps
models.blurb: Refines a draft to 2560×1440 (16:9) or 1440×2560 (9:16) with the base VAE; ~450 s on the Server Edition, silent output.

models.label: FastWan 2.1 1.3B · 3 steps
models.blurb: FastVideo's 3-step DMD distillation of Wan 2.1 1.3B. 832×480×81 in 2.2 s on a 600 W PRO 6000, 1.35 s/step on a 4090.

models.label: Self-Forcing 1.3B · long video
models.blurb: Causal block-by-block Wan 1.3B (Apache-2.0): any length at 12.9 fps on a 4090, K/V ring cache 12 + sink 3.

models.label: History Forcing 1.3B · long video (evaluation only)
models.blurb: Keeps the subject over 60 s but over-saturates; weights have no stated licence. Cache 21, sink 3.
models.verify: the converted History Forcing file is not published; convert with scripts/convert_self_forcing.py and upload before enabling

models.label: MiniMax-H3 Turbo (fastvideo-rs) · 4 steps
models.blurb: fastvideo-rs's served H3 turbo tier (FastH3 4-step LoRA on h3-base, VSA): text, image and keyframes.

models.label: MiniMax-H3 Max (fastvideo-rs)

models.label: MiniMax-H3 Draft (fastvideo-rs) · 480p TAEH3

models.blurb: Reference-to-video on the Ref2VA DiT, up to 12 references (9 images, 3 videos, 3 audios).

models.blurb: LightX2V's turbo LoRA as served by fastvideo-rs.

models.blurb: FastVideo's distilled Wan 2.2 5B: text and image to video at up to 704p.

models.blurb: The undistilled Wan 2.2 5B with CFG (steps, guidance, flow shift, negative prompt).

models.blurb: TAEHV decode for fast previews.

trees.note: `trees` entries: `weights/<tree>` and `h3-rs/<sub>` are volume paths relative to /runpod-volume; `r2:<bucket>/<prefix>=<name>` and `https:<host>/<path>=<name>` are fetched to the stage dir on first use. `stage` entries follow h3-rs make_boot.py: TREE[:SUB,SUB] copied to the container disk, the rest symlinked back.
